Plugin.Name: Fejes Mover Monitor
Plugin.Overview: Release 2026.11.18.2 for the documented Unraid 7.x scope. Hungarian, US English and German Mover/cache monitor with red/blue cache threshold controls, persistent private run logs and readable event history. Observer is the default. Optional completed-download mode moves verified complete torrents to HDD, then resumes seeding through the unchanged user-share path, without age or ratio waiting. Cache fill limits are configurable (default 75% start / 65% stop). Each invocation handles one complete unit up to 32 GiB and 128 files; incomplete and oversized units remain in cache. All maintenance, open-file, namespace and inspection guards remain. UI starts detached workers; terminal hangup protection and explicit backed-up coordinator-loss recovery are included. Fresh isolated peer, hybrid-placement, installed-scheduler and recovery tests passed on Unraid 7.3.4. Installation enables no movement or new schedule. Public tracker credit, physical power loss, mid-native-I/O termination, direct HDD downloading of oversized incomplete torrents, broad compatibility and Unraid 8 are not certified. See current evidence and limits: https://github.com/fejesgabortorrent-dot/unraid-fejes-mover-monitor/blob/main/docs/ACCEPTANCE-20261118.md
